articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level math and science benchmarks, and introduces a new "deep research" agent mode that can autonomously browse, synthesize, and cite sources over multi-step tasks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New State of the Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which achieves top scores on SWE-Bench Verified and HumanEval-Plus, outperforming previous models on real-world software engineering tasks. The model introduces improved tool use, function calling reliability, and can maintain coherent multi-file refactoring sessions across large codebases, signaling a meaningful step toward autonomous software development agents.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Fremont Factory
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started performing repetitive material-handling and inspection tasks alongside human workers at its Fremont, California facility. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for task comprehension, though Tesla acknowledges fully autonomous operation remains limited to structured environments.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C, Announces Partnerships with Amazon and BMW for Warehouse Robotics
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a massive Series C round at a $15B valuation, backed by Microsoft, Intel Capital, and Bezos Expeditions. The company announced expanded pilot deployments of its Figure 02 humanoid robot in Amazon fulfillment centers and BMW assembly lines, focusing on pick-and-place, kitting, and quality inspection tasks that require human-like dexterity.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Claude Sentinel' — An AI System That Audits Other AI Systems for Safety
articles.summary: Anthropic unveiled Claude Sentinel, a specialized model designed to continuously monitor and red-team other deployed AI systems, flagging alignment failures, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and hallucination patterns in real time. The system represents a growing industry trend toward using AI for AI governance, and Anthropic is offering it as an enterprise API for organizations running production LLM pipelines.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process technology, approximately one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. The node delivers a 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, with gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from Nvidia, Apple, and AMD in 2027.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta. Auditors are examining systemic risk assessments, training data documentation, and red-teaming reports, marking the world's first large-scale regulatory enforcement action specifically targeting general-purpose AI systems.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Modular End-Effectors
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, in collaboration with parent company Hyundai, revealed the commercial version of its electric Atlas humanoid robot featuring a modular end-effector system that allows rapid swapping between grippers, drills, and sensor packages. The platform targets automotive manufacturing, construction, and hazardous-environment inspection, with first customer shipments planned for Q4 2026.
